description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Azure Storage options in the Orleans framework, including setting up clients for tables, blobs, queues, and lease providers with support for AAD authentication.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure default Azure Storage options for various Orleans components.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the provided AzureStorageOperationOptions with default settings, including setting the TableServiceClient.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.GrainDirectory.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the provided AzureStorageOperationOptions for grain directory storage with default settings.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the provided AzureStorageOperationOptions for persistence storage with default settings.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Reminders.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures the provided AzureStorageOperationOptions for reminders storage with default settings.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Configuration.AzureBlobStorageOptions)
methods.description: Configures AzureBlobStorageOptions with either AAD credentials or connection string based on configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Configuration.AzureQueueOptions)
methods.description: Configures AzureQueueOptions with either AAD credentials or connection string based on configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (for Orleans.Configuration.AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions)
methods.description: Configures AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions with either AAD credentials or connection string based on configuration.

methods.name: GetTableServiceClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a TableServiceClient based on the current configuration, supporting AAD authentication or connection string.
